knowledge.title: SW4P category
knowledge.content: SW4P is programmable internet-native settlement for applications.

knowledge.title: SW4P outcome
knowledge.content: One settlement instruction becomes a gas-aware, fee-correct, provable and reconcilable result across supported EVM and Solana routes.

knowledge.title: SW4P evidence boundary
knowledge.content: Use reproducible route proofs, tests and dated implementation evidence. Do not present planned rails as currently live.

knowledge.title: SW4P prohibited statements
knowledge.content: Do not guarantee route coverage, transaction success, liquidity, token performance or production availability that the current evidence does not support.
